name: Together AI
tagline: Open-source model inference and fine-tuning API with serverless endpoints
description: Together AI provides a unified API for running and fine-tuning open-source large language models, image models, and embeddings. Developers call chat completions, completions, embeddings, and image generation endpoints against hosted models (Llama, Mixtral, Qwen, FLUX, and others) with OpenAI-compatible request shapes and pay-as-you-go pricing.

auth.details: Bearer token API key in Authorization header (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY); keys created in the Together dashboard after self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No free trial; minimum $5 credit purchase required for API access.
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go per million tokens / per image by model; dedicated endpoints and enterprise plans available. See together.ai/pricing.

rate_limits: not published as a single global limit; tiered by account and model (check dashboard / rate-limit headers). Default serverless limits apply per model family.

example.response_snippet: {"id": "chatcmpl-...", "object": "chat.completion", "choices": [{"index": 0, "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "Hello! How can I help you today?"}, "finish_reason": "stop"}], "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 12, "completion_tokens": 10, "total_tokens": 22}}

use_cases: run chat completions with open-source LLMs
generate text embeddings for search or RAG
fine-tune an open-source model on custom data
list available hosted models and pricing
